evals.prompt: I sell an online course for new parents who want to help their baby sleep through the night. Help me build a lead generation system that doesn't rely on paid ads.
evals.expected_output: A multi-phase workshop output that includes a lead magnet tailored to sleep-deprived new parents, a recommendation of Core Four channels (warm outreach, cold outreach, content, paid ads) with a primary and secondary channel, outreach script skeletons, and a Rule of 100 execution plan.
expectations: The output names a specific lead magnet (e.g., a guide, checklist, video, or mini-course) that solves a narrow problem for new parents.
The output recommends specific Core Four channels and names a primary channel and a secondary channel (e.g., warm outreach as primary, content as secondary).
The output includes at least one outreach script skeleton or message template for the recommended channel(s).
The output includes a Rule of 100 or 100-unit daily action plan (e.g., 100 days of warm outreach, content pieces, or direct messages).

evals.prompt: I run a residential HVAC company in Phoenix. We do repairs and replacements. I need a system to keep our pipeline full of qualified homeowners, especially before summer hits.
evals.expected_output: A multi-phase workshop output that includes a locally relevant lead magnet for Phoenix homeowners, a Core Four channel recommendation suited to home services, outreach script skeletons, and a Rule of 100 execution plan tied to seasonal demand.
expectations: The output names a specific lead magnet (e.g., an AC readiness checklist, pre-summer tune-up guide, or cost estimator) for Phoenix homeowners.
The output recommends specific Core Four channels and names a primary channel and a secondary channel appropriate for a local HVAC business.
The output includes at least one outreach script skeleton or message template for the recommended channel(s).
The output includes a Rule of 100 or 100-unit daily action plan and ties it to a time horizon (e.g., before summer, 100 days, or 100 outreach attempts).

evals.name: Copy quality dependency available
evals.prompt: business-copy-style is installed and resolvable by skill name. Start a $100M Leads workshop for my bookkeeping firm, complete discovery and channel strategy, then take me through the first point where you need to produce or approve customer-facing copy.
evals.expected_output: Normal Leads workshop behavior that delays the copy dependency check until customer-facing copy is needed, then uses the available business-copy-style quality gate without an install prompt or degraded status.
expectations: The output does not prompt about business-copy-style during discovery or strategy work that does not require customer-facing copy.
At the first customer-facing copy checkpoint, the output uses business-copy-style without asking the user to install it.
The output does not show `npx skills add George-RD/growth-arsenal --skill business-copy-style` when the skill is available.
The output does not mark the affected copy degraded or unverified when the copy-quality gate is available and completed.

evals.name: Missing copy quality dependency
evals.prompt: business-copy-style cannot be resolved by skill name. Start a $100M Leads workshop for my bookkeeping firm, complete discovery and channel strategy without dependency prompts, then reach the first customer-facing copy checkpoint. Explain my options and assume I explicitly choose to continue without installing it for now.
evals.expected_output: The workshop checks lazily at the first copy-producing or approval point, explains the unavailable shared copy-quality capability, shows the standard selective-install command, offers install-or-degraded continuation, and after the explicit degraded choice keeps the affected copy degraded/unverified with only minimum safety checks.
expectations: The output does not prompt about business-copy-style during discovery or strategy work before customer-facing copy is needed.
At the first customer-facing copy checkpoint, the output explains that the shared plain-language and de-AI copy-quality gate cannot be verified while business-copy-style is unavailable.
The output shows exactly `npx skills add George-RD/growth-arsenal --skill business-copy-style`.
The output explicitly offers installation or degraded continuation before following the requested degraded path.
The output marks the affected copy status `degraded/unverified`.
The output never claims the business-copy-style gate passed or was verified while the skill is missing.

The degraded path uses only minimum safety checks such as avoiding unsupported claims, using plain language grounded in approved facts, and surfacing assumptions or unknowns instead of fabricating specifics.
The output does not reproduce business-copy-style lint thresholds, qualitative rubrics, reader-panel methodology or other full copy-method guidance.
